Definition
[Nonlinear resolvent and Yosida approximation] ↗ thm:properties-of-subdifferentials 1. ch9:9.6.1-def-4\group Convex Analysis

  1. For each $\lambda > 0$ define the nonlinear resolvent $J_\lambda : H \to D(\partial I)$ by setting

    \[ J_\lambda [w] := u, \]

    where $u$ is the unique solution of

    \[ u + \lambda \partial I[u] \ni w. \]

  2. For each $\lambda > 0$ define the Yosida approximation $A_\lambda : H \to H$ by

    \[ A_\lambda [w] := \frac{w - J_\lambda [w]}{\lambda } \quad (w \in H). \tag {7} \]

The operator $A_\lambda $ is the Yosida regularization of $A=\partial I$.
